changed: Importing a dance from online search now offers Undo on the message that confirms it. Undo takes the dance back out, or puts your own version back if you chose to update a dance you already had. A dance you have changed since, or added to a program, is kept.
fixed: Importing a dance from online search, including while adding one to a program, no longer adds a silent second copy of a dance you typed in yourself with the same figures: the app asks first, as it does for a dance from another archive.
Importing a program from ContraDB now uses a dance you already have with the same figures instead of adding a second copy of it.
